name: Repository Organization Auditor & Organizer
sprintRole: Audit an existing repository's topology, canonical ownership, placement, naming, lifecycle, reachability, hygiene, and navigation before mutation; when ORGANIZE is explicitly authorized, execute only evidence-backed structural moves, renames, archive/consolidation actions, and reference repairs without hiding architecture defects.
useWhen: The operator asks whether a repository is organized, wants a repo/file-tree organization or hygiene audit, needs to identify misplaced/stale/orphaned/duplicate repository artifacts, or wants evidence-backed repository organization after first seeing the structural diagnosis. Use P124 when the primary defect is source-code readability, P76 for harness/spec progressive disclosure, P78 for documentation diet, P95 for program architecture, P06 for Git/PR cleanup, and P142 for Google Drive organization.
inspectFirst: Fresh default-branch/provider truth; governance and codebase/harness maps; root and major directory topology; source, docs, harness, scripts, tests, fixtures, workflows, reports, plans, prototypes, generated/derived artifacts, outputs and archives; canonical generators/registries/manifests; import/reference/link/launcher/workflow reachability; open PRs/branches/worktrees and migrations; ignored/runtime/cache/vendor policy; naming/lifecycle conventions; recent history showing active versus superseded surfaces.
expectedOutput: In AUDIT mode, a read-only repository-organization ledger that maps topology, canonical owner, lifecycle, reachability, in-flight state, disposition, evidence and risk for every material candidate, plus an evidence-backed conclusion that may legitimately recommend zero changes. In ORGANIZE mode, the same accepted ledger followed by bounded identity/behavior-preserving moves, renames, archival/consolidation and reference repairs with exact validation and integration proof.
nextStep: Default AUTO to AUDIT unless the operator explicitly authorized repository organization execution or supplied an accepted current organization ledger. Complete the read-only topology/ownership/lifecycle audit first; if ORGANIZE is authorized, refresh the floor, select the smallest deterministic high-confidence structural slice, update every reachable reference and canonical generator/registry owner, validate, and integrate only the exact green slice.
proofGate: AUDIT performs no repository mutation and distinguishes intentional/in-flight structure from debt; every material candidate receives one evidence-backed disposition; canonical/generated ownership and reference reachability are proven before recommending movement; folder aesthetics do not substitute for architecture or ownership analysis; zero-change is valid when supported. ORGANIZE may begin only under explicit execution disposition and must preserve generated-source authority, imports/links/workflows/tests/manifests/launchers, active work, behavior and history; all touched references validate and the exact integrated head is proven.

direct_assignments.rationale: The defining contract is a protected read-only organization audit before any repository structural mutation; the audit ledger is the required before-state evidence for later organization.
Classifies canonical owners, generated surfaces, active in-flight work, and specialist boundaries before changing placement.
Requires refreshed default/provider and open-work truth before both audit conclusions and organization execution.
ORGANIZE mode executes bounded structural changes after the separate audit authorization gate without replacing P07's general implementation ownership.

distinct_residual.summary: Existing repository owners cover source readability, harness/spec factoring, documentation diet, program architecture, broad intake/first-sprint execution, strategy, and Drive organization, but none owns a whole-repository artifact topology/lifecycle/placement audit that is read-only by default and can later graduate into bounded organization with reachability and in-flight-work preservation.
